name: Padru (Italy)
description: Yellow field with a blue border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Padru (a bee and oak leaves on red above green mountains) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Padru, a comune in Sardinia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Padru arms — bee and oak leaves on red above green mountains, crowned, within branches
